title: run_with_timeout doesn't actually cancel B2 SDK operations
details: ThreadPoolExecutor.cancel() only cancels the future if it hasn't started. Once the B2 SDK call is running, it cannot be interrupted. Long-running uploads/downloads will continue in background threads, potentially leaking threads and consuming resources.

title: No integrity check on state file load
details: OperationState.from_json() trusts the loaded JSON completely. No checksum/signature verification. A corrupted or tampered state file could cause incorrect resume behavior.

title: SHA-1 mismatch after upload leaves file in B2 but returns failure
details: If upload succeeds but SHA-1 verification fails (line 805-807), the file is already uploaded to B2 but we return False. On retry, this could create a duplicate or cause confusion. Should either delete the uploaded file or handle this case explicitly.

title: --skip-existing checks wrong name when object_name differs from rel_path
details: --skip-existing checks if rel_path exists in B2, but the actual upload uses object_name (which may have 'Copy of (N)' prefix if there was a collision). This means: 1) Could skip a file that has the same name but different content, 2) Could fail to skip a file that was previously uploaded with a 'Copy of' prefix.

title: populate_bucket_files_and_usage double-counts on retry
details: nonlocal_total = [0] is created once, but retry_with_backoff may call _list_and_process multiple times. Each retry continues accumulating file counts into the same list, causing used_bytes to be double/triple counted on retries.

title: build_account_state parallel mode swallows individual account errors
details: In parallel mode, future.result() will raise the first exception, but if multiple accounts fail, only the first error is seen. Also, there's no per-account retry logic in parallel mode.

title: TOCTOU race in upload_file - check-then-upload not atomic
details: Between checking if file exists in B2 (line 774) and uploading (line 785), another process could upload the same file. B2's upload_local_file will create a new version, not overwrite, so this results in duplicate versions rather than data loss. But it wastes bandwidth and storage.

title: --verify-only and --check use rel_path but uploaded name may differ
details: These modes check for files using src_file.rel_path, but the actual uploaded object_name may have 'Copy of (N)' prefix if there was a name collision. This means they won't find files that were uploaded with modified names, reporting false 'not found' or 'missing' errors.

title: Unbounded task submission in ThreadPoolExecutor
details: All items are submitted to the executor at once (future_to_path = {executor.submit(...) for item in items}). For 100K+ files, this creates 100K futures immediately, consuming memory. Should use a bounded queue or submit in batches.

title: SHA-1 computed multiple times for same file
details: compute_sha1() is called in: OperationState.create(), upload_file(), --skip-existing, --check, --verify-only, and resume verification. For large files, this is expensive. Should cache SHA-1 by file path + mtime.

title: Cached B2Api client doesn't respect realm changes
details: If you run the tool with --realm=test, then run again with --realm=production, the cached B2Api client still has the test realm authorization. The client is cached on account.client and never reset when realm changes.

title: Windows icacls failures silently ignored
details: If icacls fails (not available, permission denied, etc.), the exception is caught and ignored. The state file may remain world-readable. At minimum should log a debug message.

title: No protection against uploading from a B2 mount point
details: If source_dir is a FUSE-mounted B2 bucket, collect_source_files will read files that are being uploaded, potentially causing loops or corruption.

title: Simple log shows only filename, not relative path
details: log_progress() uses path.name (line 1019) instead of the relative path. In simple-log mode, files with same name in different directories are indistinguishable.

title: validate_config only checks file path, not content
details: validate_config() compares self.accounts_config == accounts_config (both are file paths). If the YAML content changes but file path is same, resume proceeds with stale state that may not match current bucket capacities.

title: Dry-run doesn't account for --skip-existing
details: Dry-run shows allocation before --skip-existing filtering. User sees 'X files to upload' but actual upload would be fewer. Misleading for capacity planning.

title: No Unicode normalization for filenames
details: Filenames with different Unicode normalizations (NFC vs NFD) are treated as different by B2 but may appear identical to users. Could cause confusion or duplicates.

title: Non-atomic state file write on Windows
details: Path.write_text() is not atomic on Windows. If interrupted during write, state file could be corrupted. Should write to temp file then rename.

title: Broad exception catch in populate_bucket_files_and_usage
details: Catches all Exception, not just B2Error. Could mask bugs like AttributeError from SDK changes.
